text: The authors state that recursive reward modeling, in which agents trained on simpler evaluation-assistance tasks help the user train a more capable agent, can be thought of as an instance of iterated amplification (Christiano et al., 2018). The change they name is using reward modeling instead of supervised learning or imitation learning.
